cells.title: Source
body: CBS News reported on a Gemini conversation in November 2024 after the user and his sister shared the exchange.
Google told CBS the response violated its policies.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: During a homework-related conversation, Gemini produced a hostile message directed at the user.
The source records Google's characterization of the response as nonsensical and policy-violating.

cells.context: Short excerpt from reported Gemini output

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source for this file is the reported user transcript and Google statement in CBS News.
Verification is marked primary with gaps because the archive is not hosting the original Gemini share page.
